name: Nancy
quote:
We loved staying in this cute carriage house. After being on the road for a week, it was nice to be in a a cozy home where we could do our laundry and prepare a few meals ourselves. I especially appreciated the make up mirror in the bathroom (and that is wasn't attached to the wall, like in hotels). The neighborhood is quiet and the carriage house's location behind the main house made us feel safe and secure. 

The carriage house is close to downtown, so we could easily walk to restaurants, downtown shopping and to nearby historial houses.
